posts.text: I am holding substantial qty since 2018. Apparently a large number of retail shareholders who used to be very active on this thread seem to have left. This is sad. In my opinion, this bank has definitely crossed the turnaround point in Q1 and is now on way to its compounder story. This was repeatedly promised by the management only to be tripped first by Covid and then by microfinance loans. Let us keep our fingers crossed for next few quarters. posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: The 515 crores received from CGFMU has not been written back and has instead been used to create a contingency provision buffer for any unforseen future macro/geopolitical events. Thus it has been excluded from Q1 profits. If it were included in Q1 profits - the the profit figure of Q1 would have been around 1460 crores.
